verdict.rationale: decK provides declarative, bulk configuration management ("APIOps") letting users sync/diff entire sets of services, routes, and plugins in one operation, and the Admin API/kongctl support programmatic bulk changes across many entities. This directly satisfies bulk operations across many items, though it's framed as general API-lifecycle automation rather than AI-agent-specific tooling.  missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk operations on AI-native entities (AI Models, MCP tools, agents) via decK/kongctl, and independent/hands-on verification of bulk-sync behavior at scale.
